name: gnomAD (Genome Aggregation Database)
summary: Population allele frequencies of human genetic variants and per-gene constraint metrics from the Broad Institute's gnomAD, through the GraphQL API behind its browser.
notes: Keyless. GraphQL only: one POST taking query and variables.
Rate limit: 10 requests per IP address per 60 seconds. Batch several lookups into one query, and use the bulk downloads for large-scale work.

Root fields include gene(gene_id or gene_symbol, reference_genome), variant(variantId or rsid, dataset), region(chrom, start, stop, reference_genome), transcript, clinvar_variant, structural_variant, gene_search and variant_search.
reference_genome is GRCh37 or GRCh38; dataset names a gnomAD release (e.g. gnomad_r4).

endpoints.name: Run a GraphQL query
endpoints.summary: Any query over genes, variants, regions and transcripts: allele frequencies, constraint, ClinVar links.
